title: Meta AI media access lacked object-ownership authorization
summary: A missing media-ownership check earned a USD 10,000 award, according to the researcher.
root_cause: A media-editing API did not bind the requested object to the authenticated owner.
impact: Another user’s private prompts and generated media could be disclosed. The reproduced vendor response says no abuse was found.
defensive_takeaways: Apply object-ownership checks consistently across media access and editing operations.
Track temporary mitigation separately from confirmation of a complete fix.

reward.evidence_location: Timeline, corroborated by the reproduced vendor response in Fix & Meta’s Response.
reward.notes: The researcher explicitly states USD and reproduces the vendor award decision. Settlement is unverified.
